reference: ProviderInstanceRegistry forks native adapters into parent-owned scopes and closes them when their scope ends. Server teardown is not a user Stop command.
observed: Private container probe of83ce347: SIGTERM while a native turn is active can persist a failed run before the server exits.
The same probe with445f545 and an active goal already preserves the run; no deterministic active-goal SIGTERM regression in445f545 is claimed.
445f545 is installed on NODE and M2; real HTTP snapshots for the two reported NODE threads retain assistant answers and active native goals, and both runs returned to running after restart.
implemented: Mark server teardown before closing native transports, serializing the receipt fence with the database writer.
Ignore late native receipts after teardown begins, so transport closure cannot create failure cards, terminalize durable work or replace its goal.
Do not issue user Stop or native goal-control commands during shutdown.
Generated systemd units use KillMode=mixed so SIGTERM reaches the supervising server before native children are reaped.

validation.lateReceipts: A native transport failure, interruption and paused-goal notification after teardown leave the run running and the stored goal active; no failure card.
